name: root-crate-artifacts-split
body: Wave G of the multi-wave task-19 root-crate decomposition (behaviour-preserving, CLI unchanged). `src/artifacts.rs` is decomposed into `src/artifacts/{db,merge,project}.rs` plus `src/artifacts/mod.rs`. `ParsedArgs` and `parse_args` stay in `mod.rs` (preserved), and the module FQN `rust.apg.artifacts` stays. `src/artifacts/tests.rs` stays put, so the test module FQN `rust.apg.artifacts.tests` stays. `ArtifactDb` is declared in `db.rs`, so its methods render under `rust.apg.artifacts.db.ArtifactDb.*` though the impl blocks span db/merge/project. Zero durable `implemented-by` edges target an artifacts unit.
